name: Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haiduk Paths Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The route passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses used by haiduks as refuges. It follows ancient paths used by the haiduks and offers the chance to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The route passes 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine terrain with bare rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient haiduk paths and hiking trails
additional: The route passes historic fortresses and natural landmarks. The race takes place in the last week of October, with variations in weather conditions and difficulty.

name: Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of varying levels. The routes offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and trail runners to enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: 38 km with 1,100 m of elevation gain
26 km with 700 m of elevation gain
11 km with 330 m of elevation gain
additional: The event is associated with mountain running and hiking, and is expected to take place in October 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain race that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic nature trails and offers a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.
course_highlights: Mountain and sea landscapes
Part of the international Kom–Emine route
A range of distances from 4 to 50 km
additional: The event is scheduled for October 18, 2026, and includes various distances suitable for runners with different levels of fitness. The routes pass through scenic natural areas in Elenite.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years, featuring half-marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race-walking tournament has also been held, attracting athletes from various towns in Bulgaria. The organizers, SCA “Spartak - Koynare,” ensure professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for the participation of Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a history spanning more than 30 years
Includes half-marathons, road races, and track meets
A race-walking tournament on a 1 km loop
additional: The race-walking tournament takes place on a 1 km loop. Athletes of various ages from different towns compete. Among the judges is Lyubomir Ivanov, the national record holder in the 20 km race walk. Full results and photos have been published on the event’s Facebook page. A race-walking tournament with participants from across Bulgaria, a 1 km course, held for the first time in Koynare’s history.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes race is an ultrarunning event held in the Krumovgrad area, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The courses pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments, such as Sheytan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the wilderness and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing and photographers, and participants can also run with pets. The use of reusable water bottles is encouraged.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheytan Dere
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
Pets are welcome, with water and treats available at the aid stations
additional: Course marking, medals, timing and photographers are provided. Participants can run with pets, with water and treats available for them at the aid stations. Reusable water bottles or cups are recommended to reduce plastic use. Courses: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious competition that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for challenging races in a natural and demanding setting. The event offers young and experienced runners the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment is used, with live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24. The race will take place in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG. The course is in the area around the town.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
organizer: Балканска атлетика (АБАФ), атлетически клуб „Спартак“ – Койнаре, община Червен бряг
description: The 2026 Balkan Cross Country Championships will be held in Koynare, Bulgaria, on November 7. The event is organized by the local Spartak-Koynare Athletics Club in cooperation with the town hall, Cherven Bryag Municipality, and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The course is designed around the stadium and the athletics club buildings, near the town center, and will welcome more than 600 athletes and guests. Koynare is an established host of running competitions, with a long-standing tradition and experience in organizing sporting events.
course_highlights: The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings in the center of Koynare
Several luxury hotels are available within a 20 km radius
Koynare has actively organized running events for more than 30 years
additional: More than 600 athletes, team representatives, referees, organizers, and fans are expected to attend. The event is part of the sports calendar of Balkan Athletics and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. In late October 2026, Koynare will also host the national cross country championships as preparation for the Balkan Championships. The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings, and hotels within a 20 km radius can accommodate more than 600 participants and guests.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
description: First Rifle Trail is a mountain running event in Koprivshtitsa that brings together sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy beautiful autumn views, historic sites, and the atmosphere of the old town. The 25 km and 35 km distances are part of the international UTMB Index network, offering the opportunity to take part in the World Series.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in Koprivshtitsa. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance. Children under 13 may take part in the 10 km distance only with an accompanying adult. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be run in the opposite direction. The cutoff time for 25 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes, and for 35 km it is 6 hours and 30 minutes.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the largest classic races in the RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The event offers a unique experience in nature, with varied courses suited to different levels of runners. The routes follow scenic trails and offer challenges that will appeal to both recreational and experienced runners. Organized by Trail Series, the race is part of a seasonal series that brings together runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of the village of German
Scenic trails and varied terrain
Suitable for different levels of runners
additional: The event takes place on 8 November 2026, from 11:00 to 15:00, in the village of German. The organizer is Trail Series. Google Maps directions to the location are available. No specific prices or registration categories have been published on the pages at this time. A trail race on varied terrain, including asphalt and trails; registration details are not specified.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

name: Витоша Ски и Дъски
location: Aleko Hut, Vitosha Nature Park, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Ski and Board is an event organized by the Sofia Mountain Club Association, held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut. The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
location: Център на село Марково, Plovdiv Province, Bulgaria
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains, around the village of Markovo in Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22 and 44 km—as well as a 700-metre children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo mayor’s office and organised by the Plovdiv and Rhodope Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Club.
course_highlights: Courses of 8, 12, 22 and 44 km in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains
Aid stations with water, electrolytes, fruit, snacks and special food
Well-marked and secured routes with timing and electronic results tracking
additional: Race packs include a race number, gifts and surprises from sponsors. The 8 km race includes a designer headband; the 12 and 22 km races include a designer organic cotton T-shirt; and the 44 km race includes a designer fleece vest. A headlamp is mandatory equipment. The children’s race is 700 metres long and free for children up to 8 years old. Parking is arranged on streets marked in red; motor vehicles are not permitted in the start/finish area. The awards ceremony begins at 12:00 and takes place in stages. In editions for which information is available, the start and expo area are in the centre of Markovo. Information about the distances and conditions refers to previous editions.

name: Велинград Ултра
price_range: 23 евро за тениска, други цени не са посочени
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the Spa Capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose from 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event offers professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: Courses of 11 km (520 m elevation gain), 27 km (1,420 m elevation gain), and 43 km (2,100 m elevation gain)
Mountain terrain with marked trails and aid stations
Start and finish in the center of Velingrad—the Spa Capital of the Balkans
additional: Race packs include a medal, an event-logo souvenir, timing, and a race number. Registration and race-pack collection are from 07:00 to 11:00 on race day. Cutoff times are set for the 27 km and 43 km distances. Event T-shirts are available for purchase for 23 euros. Mandatory additional equipment is not included in the race pack. The courses include different distances; registration is on 4 April 2026. The event includes medals, photos, and aid stations; additional equipment is required.

name: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Великденски Маратон 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sporting event in Stara Zagora featuring trail running and mountain biking. Organized by the Zaratа Cycling and Tourism Club Association, with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality and TD Sarnena Gora, the competition offers various running and cycling distances in Ayazmoto Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Trail running and mountain biking in Ayazmoto Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km and 38 km (ultra)
eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course
additional: Registration and race-number pickup from 07:00 to 08:00. Cyclists must wear helmets. Payment is accepted only by bank transfer or at an EasyPay counter after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI card holders). Awards ceremony at 17:00 for both disciplines. The cycling courses will include an approximately 32 km hobby course and a 42 km ultra course; online registration, payment by bank transfer; valid insurance and helmets are required for cyclists.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletic talents. The tournament takes place at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of different ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series
Memorial tournament honoring Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Khristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in the natural surroundings of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event features mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, giving participants and guests the chance to enjoy the region’s nature and landmarks. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers a range of distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at people who enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with checkpoints and time limits for the longer distances
Running and cycling events held on two separate days
Opportunity to visit local landmarks and enjoy evening entertainment between the event days
additional: The race includes children’s starts over short distances, cut-off times, and stops at set kilometre points for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). Cycling distances range from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at Acad. N. Haytov Square in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The events include mountain running and cycling over various distances; participation is subject to rules covering equipment and physical fitness. Online registration is available, with different participant categories.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000-Metre Track Championship in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s top athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometre track distance. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: A track race over the classic 10,000 m distance
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s national sports calendar
additional: The first national 10,000 m track championship in Hisarya is included in the 2026 sports calendar.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and no-kill shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to the 21 km half marathon. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social interaction.
course_highlights: Course: 50% asphalt and 50% gravel park paths
Aid stations at different kilometer points depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Race bib pickup is available April 21–23, from 9:00 to 19:00, in the South Wing of the Rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and awards ceremony. Games, raffles, opportunities for social interaction, and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and many prizes.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is Bulgaria’s largest spring mountain running event, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a beginner-friendly 10 km race, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The courses pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, the Balkan Mountains, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by Begach Sports Club and attracts more participants every year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain through Lozen Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain to Mount Bachun
10 km courses with around 100 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Race kits can be collected on the Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. There are aid stations and medical assistance along the courses. The race provides no cups, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A bag drop is available, but the organizers are not responsible for lost belongings. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are stationed at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear their race bib on their chest or abdomen. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hiking; an event focused on nature and social activities; date: April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of Bankya and heading toward Ostra Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which features a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The figure-eight course starts on the northern outskirts of Bankya
Each loop is 6.4 km long with 217 m of elevation gain
Choose one or two loops (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course was designed by Miroslav Spasov. The race is held at the site of a spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar, alongside other events in Sofia and across the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The course crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is excellent strength and endurance training, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start in the village of Bistritsa, with easy access by bus No. 98
Gradual but demanding climb with 500 m of elevation gain to the Kikish area
Panoramic views of Sofia and an opportunity to rest and refuel at Kamen Del Hut
additional: The route features varied surfaces, from forest trails to rocky sections, helping runners adapt to different conditions. In the Kikish area, the shelter offers cover and food on weekends. Running in nature provides a chance to recover away from the noise of the city. Terrain, marathon preparation, natural setting

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls takes place on April 26, 2026, in Bistritsa village, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain race for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors; communication is handled directly with them. The event is a tradition and attracts athletes looking for a competitive experience on mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain race in the area of Bistritsa village, Sofia
Competition for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contacting the organizer is recommended for any questions. The competition is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series, focuses on uphill running, and offers participation opportunities for different age groups.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and runs through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized course with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat course suitable for all levels
Runs alongside the Maritsa River and relaxation areas with water views
The 10 km course consists of 2 laps of the park
additional: Race packs can be collected in advance on May 1 from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. The starts are on May 2: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and the 1 km children’s run at 10:20. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at 11:40. 40% of entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, while the winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. Sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a prize raffle are planned. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kodzha Kaya is the first fully self-supported ultramarathon in Bulgaria, held in the village of Bilka, in the area of Mount Kodzha Kaya. The race offers a range of distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. It is an event for adventure and mountain-running enthusiasts that leaves a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4,400 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
42 km marathon with over 2,700 m of elevation gain and no aid stations
30 km Sky with 1,950 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
additional: All distances are fully self-supported, with no aid stations. There is also an additional challenge: a vertical climb up Kodzha Kaya, 3.6 km with 500 m of elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural setting rich in flora and fauna, offering stunning views and challenging terrain. The race is held on May 1–2, 2026, and participants can choose from a range of distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to age 14, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, paths, river, relaxation area, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is available online or on site on the event day, subject to the availability of race bibs. Late registration is available after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and cash and in-kind prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children’s race and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and the community.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gain, challenging participants with a true mountain experience. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and in-kind prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain ranging from 420 m to 1,640 m
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets will be distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at Olympic Square. Participants under 16 may take part only in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and the prizes for the top three places are cash and in-kind prizes. Participants are advised to complete the participation declarations in advance. Payment is currently accepted only by bank transfer. The distances are 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km, with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1,640 m, respectively; the start and finish are at Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses run through mountain and forest terrain.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as boys and girls under 20, under 18 and under 16, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18 and 16
Held in the scenic area of Chepelare
additional: For any questions, participants should contact the organizer directly at the email address provided to them. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is held with official support. It is part of the national mountain running calendar and offers the opportunity to compete in different age categories.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow competitors.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop
Held in St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance: 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Each race day starts at 8:00. Each participant must wear a visible race number on the front. Laps are counted by a judge, who changes every six hours. A camera-based backup counting system is also in place. If a participant pauses the race or leaves the course, they must inform the judge. A “hotel lap” may be counted when leaving and rejoining the course at designated points. Alcohol consumption, smoking, and drug use are prohibited in the camp and on the course. A minimum running dress code applies in the park, and running shirtless is not permitted. Official results are published the following day at around 9:00 on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Course: paved track, 785 m; registration until 1 April 2026; personal assistant fee: 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Haydushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete to climb the iconic path from its starting point to the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel. The route offers several variations of differing difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who climbs the path in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for lovers of mountain running and nature.
course_highlights: Climb the iconic Haydushka Path in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with several variations—the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder’s name is added to a special sign at the start of the path. Results for participants with a time under 1 hour are published on the website of the Old Elm Foundation. The event features trail running on different routes and has no categories or prizes, with an emphasis on personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honour of Haji Dimitar’s birthday and St. George’s Day—the Day of Bravery. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a vojvoda. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, with alpine-type terrain
The course follows ancient hajduk trails and passes near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
An area with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the Old Elm Foundation’s traditional patriotic initiatives and is held in honour of historical figures and events connected with the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Sinite Kamani Nature Park Information Centre; competitions include stone and knife throwing. Participants are encouraged to wear traditional folk costumes.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Mladost” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This competition has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from different countries to compete in a range of track and field events. The tournament focuses on developing youth sport and offers talented athletes under 18 an opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize that registered performances are required for entry in some events, such as the girls’ long jump.
course_highlights: Competitions at the City Stadium in Ruse
International participation by boys and girls under 18
21 track and field events
additional: Registered performances are required to enter the girls’ under-18 long jump; competitors without them will not be admitted. The competition includes 21 events and more than 300 participants. Results and start lists are publicly available. The competition is open to young athletes under 18 and is part of their preparation for European championships and international competitions.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, crossing the Rui, Ezimir and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: The routes pass the peaks of Mali Rui, Orlovets and Rakitski Kamik, and the Erma River Gorge
Varied terrain: soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes and panoramic views
additional: All courses are circular, starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. There are aid stations with water and food along the courses, but cups are not provided. Every participant is covered by mandatory insurance. Medical staff and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. The courses are circular, with aid stations and medical assistance; participants must carry mandatory equipment and use GPS tracks. The race is part of a series of courses and is certified by ITRA.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and consists of three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final ascent via a via ferrata. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all proceeds go toward restoring the hut. It’s a chance to test yourself against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.
course_highlights: MTB cycling: 21 km with +350 m elevation gain
Running: 10 km with +220 m elevation gain
Final ascent via the newest via ferrata in Northern Bulgaria
additional: The start is in front of Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo village. Relay teams consist of two people, and the entry fee is for the whole team. Relay categories are men’s, women’s, and mixed. The event supports the restoration of Alpinist Hut. Courses: MTB 21 km, running 10 km, via ferrata; categories: individual and relay; location: Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo; date: May 9, 2026.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held near the village of Zheleznitsa, close to Sofia. The course is just over 5 km and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometre completed, Amusnet donates €5 to support Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 0–3 km: Flat and beautiful forest trail
3–4 km: A demanding climb of around 1 km
4–5+ km: Descent and a final sprint to the finish
additional: Professional timing, with results published after the event. Parking near the start is limited; participants are advised to use the large car park at the edge of the village, around 2 km from the start/finish area. Participation is free. The course is just over 5 km with varied terrain; support for Paralympians; registration via the form; limited parking capacity; prizes for participants and staff.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Trun Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the scenic Kraishte region, with the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality, as its hub. The race offers four courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, crossing the Ruй, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas. Organized by the Trun Tourist Association with the support of Trun Municipality, the race provides course markings, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.
course_highlights: Four loop courses of 14 km, 23 km, 43 km, and 64 km, with elevation gains from 700 to 3,300 meters
Routes through the Rui, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views
Varied terrain with soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas
additional: All courses are loop routes starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. Aid stations along the courses provide water and food, but cups are not provided. Mandatory insurance is taken out for every participant. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. Multiple courses of different lengths, with routes through scenic Bulgaria, are awaiting ITRA certification.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run across the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vast sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature lovers and runners seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km of rugged coastal beauty with an endless horizon
17 km along breathtaking cliffs with a sea breeze
7 fast and impressive kilometres along the coast
additional: Race packs are collected in the cities of Varna and Shabla, with a signed participation declaration. To collect a race pack for another participant, their signed declaration is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, the waves, and the journey, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from partner Villa Daros. The event features races over different distances, is supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amid the natural scenery of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to the cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot “Slancheto” in Borisova Gradina and take part using the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular “Slancheto” area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of paved park paths
1.2 km of dirt-and-gravel path, followed by 1.8 km of wide paved road
additional: The race is accessible to wheelchair participants. The virtual Catcher Car begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to take part and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or in person. The event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race included in the XLkmrun calendar and organized by 5kmrun. It takes place around the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—over open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The course is open, with no shade and varied terrain
Held in the Plana Mountain, near Sofia
additional: A choice of three distances of varying lengths. The course is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May around the village of Plana. Trail race; distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km; held around the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. It attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. The event is part of Lukovit Municipality’s sports calendar and offers a mass 800-meter start for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The 8.8-kilometer course runs from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass 800-meter start for younger participants
Takes place in scenic natural and urban surroundings
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. Winner Ismail Senandzhi has won the race five times. The event also includes a mass 800-meter start. It takes place on 10 May 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular with running enthusiasts in the region.

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for all running enthusiasts. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak. The course passes through urban areas, bike paths, and a secondary road network, with approximately 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and features aid stations every 5 km, as well as prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: The first 10 km pass through urban areas
The course follows bike paths and a secondary road network
Approximately 100 meters of elevation gain
additional: Race packs can be collected on May 8 and 9, 2026, at the Orlovo Gnezdo Tourist Association office, and on May 10, 2026, at the start/finish area in Rosarium Park. Aid stations along the course provide water, drinks, and fruit approximately every 5 km. The start/finish area has designated personal-bag storage zones with tags bearing race numbers. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00 and includes overall and youth categories. On-site registration is from 08:00 to 09:00, and the start is at 09:00. The event offers different distances and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The 20th anniversary edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, creating opportunities for young talents and established sportspeople to compete. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports officials.
course_highlights: City stadium in Lukovit with a well-maintained track
Events from 100 m to 1500 m for different age groups
More than 200 athletes from 35 clubs across the country
additional: The competition includes different age groups, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m. Representatives of Lukovit Municipality and sports officials attend the awards ceremonies. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and attracts national-level athletes and young talents. It is held at the city stadium in Lukovit, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m, includes children and adults, and features participants from across the country.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers different distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.
course_highlights: The course runs along Shumen Reservoir
Options for individual and relay running
A range of time formats: 1, 2, 3, and 6 hours
additional: Options include individual runs lasting 6 hours and 3 hours, as well as mixed relays lasting 2 hours and 1 hour (under 18 years old).

name: Business Run Varna

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Цена: 19 евро на дете. Регистрацията е индивидуална и отделна.

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the biggest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard Shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km before handing the relay baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams of 4, each running 4 km
The course is in the industrial zone of BulYard Shipbuilding Industry and Bulport Logistics
Each lap is 2 km, and each participant runs 2 laps
additional: Each participant receives a race bib and safety pins. The relay baton is equipped with an electronic timing chip. The start is at 9:00, and the first runner must be at the start with the baton at 8:50. Parking and a cloakroom are available next to the start area. Laser engraving on medals is available for an additional fee. Branded team tents are available for an additional fee. Registration deadlines are in early 2026. The event includes certificates and gifts, as well as the opportunity for companies to take part and enjoy team-building.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professional runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The event brings together sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty: 3 km with 75 m of elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m of elevation gain, and 26 km with 1,514 m of elevation gain
Routes follow historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: The organizers are Apriltsi Municipality, the Troyan in the Future Association, and the National Society “Tradition” – 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with funds raised allocated to causes related to the fight against cancer and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event is organized to bring together sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different levels of difficulty and welcoming both professional runners and enthusiasts. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and scenic sea views. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon tests endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course runs along Varna’s coastline, with sea views
The race takes place in Bulgaria’s seaside capital
An atmosphere of support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late on-site registration is possible if places are available at the information center, which is open May 12–16, 2026. Race numbers can only be collected in person on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square, next to the Varna Opera House. The event also includes a 2 km city run with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; online and on-site registration; an event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Pleven Friendship Marathon is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. The organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a varied program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turn-around points
Refreshment stations every 5–6 km and water stations every 3 km and along the course
The course passes through Kaylaka Park and scenic parts of Pleven
additional: Race packets are distributed at the Children’s Activity Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed in on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and an ambulance on the course. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIZ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 and people with disabilities upon request and submission of documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Course, registration, charitable cause, children’s marathon

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held in the foothills of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event brings together sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: The Hobby route is 37 km with 1,274 m of elevation gain, suitable for cyclists of all levels.
The Difficult route is 47 km with 1,781 m of elevation gain, featuring challenging climbs and technical descents for advanced riders.
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the cycling route overlapping the Hobby route.
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, aid stations with food and drinks, a medical team, and festival activities at the start/finish area, including live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children’s race for children up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start/finish area. It includes a children’s race, a tent campsite, insurance, aid stations, and charitable giving.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its founding in 2026. Held in the village of Sinemorets, it offers trail running distances of 42, 21, and 13 km, plus a 3 km children’s race, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The routes follow the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start on May 23, with time limits for each distance. Mountain biking takes place on May 24, with two distances. Starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). Food and drink stations are provided along the routes. MTB bikes without electric assistance are permitted. After the race, there is a party at the “Koraba” bar. Early accommodation booking is recommended, for example at Casa Domingo in Sinemorets. Running and cycling routes, on-site registration, anniversary edition, nature trails in Strandzha

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with breathtaking views and challenges. This event combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature to create an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance featuring challenging and scenic mountain trails
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: The race offers distances from 6K to 95K, suitable for runners of different levels. There is a special race for children: DECATHLON Kids Run. A prize draw is held every month for registered participants. Multiple distances, mountain running, prize draw registration, children's race

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The Yordanka Arizanova Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes, who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Events at Plovdiv Stadium
Events: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditionally attracts accomplished sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes starts for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. The winners are presented with awards by Yordanka Arizanova’s daughter, Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is annual and takes place at Plovdiv Stadium; it includes the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards presented to the winners.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with varied climbs and descents
Beautiful natural views around the village of Zhelyava
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria and is aimed at amateurs and professionals who want to test themselves in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking competition in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying distances and elevation gain, suited to different categories of competitors, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes cross scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic – 62 km with 2,505 m of elevation gain
Murgash Classic – 40 km with 1,348 m of elevation gain
Zhelyava Trail – an iconic section with a 9.9 km climb
additional: The race includes junior boys’ and girls’ categories in different age groups, as well as an e-bike category with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes of varying distances and elevation gain are suitable for different fitness levels, including an e-bike category.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wilderness of Vitosha. The race features three distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Courses of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2,000, 1,300, and 600 meters
Passage over Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha (2,290 m)
Varied terrain: forest trails, wet peat, rocky paths, streams, and moraines
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip. The awards ceremony takes place in front of Aleko Hut after the third finisher in each distance and group crosses the finish line. Every participant receives a medal and a one-week gym training pass at Next Level. Participants who have paid the entry fee receive a 30% discount on Salomon products and 10% on Suunto products at Sport Box. GPS devices are recommended for navigating the courses. The courses range from 12 km to 40 km and include an ascent of Cherni Vrah; conditions include mud, rocks, forests, and open meadows; registration is online or on site.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The Under-18 National Championship in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides young athletics talents with an opportunity to compete and develop.
course_highlights: Track competitions in Stara Zagora
Participation by young athletes under 18
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The competition will bring together young athletes from across the country and will be an important part of the national sports program for young people.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain routes and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of courses featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with peaks and valleys
River crossings and forest trails
The scenic natural beauty of the Rhodope Mountains
additional: All participants who finish within the cutoff time receive a finisher’s medal for the 60 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 9 km distances. Included are a T-shirt with an original design, gifts in the race pack, timing, a medical examination when collecting the race number, medical teams during the event, race photography, and securing all necessary permits. Multiple routes, mountain terrain, natural beauty, and a race for amateurs and professionals.
