description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. The race features teams of 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run events, and every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active time with colleagues.
course_highlights: Relay: 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km (4.8 km total)
Power Walk: a team of 4 completes one 4 km lap together
CEO Dash: one 1.2 km lap
additional: Every participant receives accident insurance from MetLife for the day of the event. Each team receives a set of beach towels, an assembled medal, a plaque showing the company's placing, and gifts from partners. Laser engraving on the medals is available (€40 excluding VAT per team), as is a branded tent (€1,000 excluding VAT). Arriving at least an hour early is recommended; a cloakroom is available. The car park at Vasil Levski Stadium is closed, so taking the metro is recommended. A team-building event with various activities, company participation, an urban course, and different prices depending on the registration date.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championships for under-14 athletes in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents the opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Events at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo
Classic track and field events for under-14 athletes
Two-day format with more than 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Otvad Mosta is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants pass over four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Crossing four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as the Kakrina Inn and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is available online or in person on certain days. During the last two weeks before the event, registration is available with restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise is available in on-site sizes. The fee is determined by the time of payment. A medical examination is not required for the 5 km run. Included are aid stations with food and drinks, a finisher’s medal, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. Duathlon: 40 km cross-country cycling + 12 km running; charity campaign; historical routes; nature views.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 метра, 1500 метра, 0.8 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: The “Nikola Valchanov” athletics tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprints and shot put, for age groups ranging from under-14s to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and begins with an official opening at 11:00.
course_highlights: Events at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 events, including sprints and shot put
Participation across age groups, from under-14s to men and women
additional: The tournament’s official opening is at 11:00 at Aprilov Stadium. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event features events for different age groups. The tournament includes 17 events, with participants from 23 clubs, and has a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes an ascent of Golyam Kadamliya (2,275.4 m), the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event for lovers of mountain running and nature combines a challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Ascent of Golyam Kadamliya Peak — 2,275.4 m
Passage through three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The race starts in the village of Tazha. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packs can be collected both on the evening before the race and on race day, from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. The awards ceremony begins at 14:00. All winners receive a singlet bearing the race logo. A designer singlet can be ordered during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the 12K and 20K, with a parental consent form. Refunds are available until 30.04.2026, subject to a 20% fee; no refunds are available after that date. The organizers are looking for volunteers to help with the event. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 places is reached; designer singlets can be ordered during registration; the event includes social events and a camping option.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment in nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrain
Scenic views of the Belogradchik Rocks
A unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race “In the Kingdom of the TribAlletes” is a unique event in the heart of the Vratsa Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with almost 1,000 metres of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak Waterfall and the peaks of Dudil and Buk, combining tough climbs with technical descents. The race is for those who appreciate natural beauty and mountain running, and prizes are placed along the course, including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwest Bulgaria as a destination for sport and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with almost 1,000 m of elevation gain
Passes beneath Borov Kamak Waterfall, which is over 70 m high
Technical, steep descent from Buk Peak, with views of the Vratsa Balkan and the Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance to the Borov Kamak eco-trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the toughest, with the biggest climb. Prizes are placed along the course. Register by calling 0878 259 772. The course features waterfalls, climbs, descents, technical sections, and natural beauty.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The 16th Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, singing, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folk performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances by traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunities to take part in or observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants submit applications through an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, covering different folk genres in a competitive format. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO to provide advisory services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from across Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities to exchange traditions.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances suited to skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience amid Bulgaria’s natural scenery, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site
Stunning views and a skyrunning course
A range of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points, respectively, from a previous race are required to register. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times before the start. Transport to the start area is provided for the 25 km distance. The awards ceremony takes place at Central Square in Bansko. A multi-distance race featuring an ultramarathon and mountain routes, with exceptional natural views.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop of around 5 km with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose from three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop of around 5 km
Held in Vrana Park, on the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation gain along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is one loop of around 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The minimal elevation gain makes it suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and offers different distances. It is held in Vrana Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park, with the start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park with varied terrain
Start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State
Includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, bicycles must meet EU requirements, with a speed limit of 25 km/h and a power limit of 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on site.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings, near Koprinka Reservoir in Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: 2 km swim along the sandy shores of Koprinka Reservoir
60 km cycling through the forests of Sredna Gora over rugged terrain
15 km run through the forest and along the reservoir shore, with panoramic views
additional: Cutoff times: swimming — 1:40 hours; cycling — 5:30 hours; running — 2:30 hours. Any time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is limited to people over 18. The day before the race, there is a children’s race for different age groups. Courses: 2 km swimming, 60 km cycling, 14 km running; registration at different prices; included: medals, aid stations, professional timing, medical support, bicycle service, prizes, and photos.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a waste-free race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: A 9-stage loop around Vitosha, passing through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultramarathon with varied terrain and elevation
Start and finish in front of Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the ALPI store in Sofia and at the start, up to 60 minutes before the race. The race emphasizes environmental protection: participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. A special SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels is available. The awards ceremony takes place on race day after the finish. The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon disciplines. The course includes remote parts of the mountain, with a total elevation gain of over 2,000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of a mountain ultramarathon and cycling event.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. It is organized by the Troyan in the Future Association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km and 70 km, with varying elevation gain
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan, featuring natural and historical landmarks
Open to both professionals and enthusiasts
additional: Race packs are collected on site, with priority given to participants in the longer distances. Participants must carry their race number, a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and a mobile phone with the organizers’ number. The program includes a technical briefing and an awards ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events promoting an active lifestyle

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose from an ultra-distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for an active holiday in the national resort of Varshets.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a range of distances
Start in front of Hotel Medicus in the town of Varshets
Routes through scenic natural surroundings
additional: Race packs can be collected at Varshets Municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12–13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start at Hotel Medicus; online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach between Kamchia Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and aids provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River.
The distances are 10 km and 21.1 km, with aid stations approximately every 5 km.
Runners can run barefoot, and rescue equipment is provided for the river crossing.
additional: The start is in the evening. Race numbers are distributed from 15:00, and baggage storage is available. The time limits are 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3 hours 30 minutes for 10 km. Children can take part in the 2.2 km children’s run for free. Participants must bring a water container for the aid stations. Timing uses RFID chips. In unfavorable conditions, the river crossing may be made by boats provided by the organizers. Registration is available online and on site. Fees can be paid via EasyPay or ePay. Accompaniment is available, and children under 7 may participate with an accompanying adult.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the scenic resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a 48 km ultra distance
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
A 1 km distance for children and beginners
additional: The start is in front of Hotel Medicus. Race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of Hotel Medicus; registration at www.runbulgaria.org

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. Held at a stadium in Sofia, it offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talent in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Stadium competition in Sofia
Participation by the best athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, which has a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will bring together young athletes from across the country.

description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. Route from the village of Pastra to Kalin Reservoir in the Rila Mountains

Routes on natural trails and cart roads

The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.

25 km single-track course climbing toward Zeleni Preslap, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes

The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place at the end of September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and earns points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.
course_highlights: Routes cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains
Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Aid stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, and Rhodope specialties
additional: The entry pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts. A medical examination before participation is mandatory. Medical assistance and mountain insurance are provided. Aid stations offer water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The course has minimal asphalt sections. Electronic timing of results. Information about accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photography and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, highlighting nature, history, and adventure, while supporting environmental causes.

description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gain; all qualify for the UTMB Index and earn points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the fairytale-like Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 13 to 100 km through the Rhodope Mountains
Total positive elevation gain of up to 4,170 m on the 100 km course
UTMB Index-qualifying race with marked and secured routes
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, gifts, and a special surprise. Medical examinations are mandatory and are conducted on site at no extra cost. The event provides mountain insurance and medical assistance during the race. A medical certificate is not required; participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, transport to the start points is provided, the event supports green initiatives, and it is well organized.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive long-distance race of 10.25 km and a short 2023-meter distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining seaside scenery with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.
course_highlights: Long-distance 10.25 km course along the Black Sea beach
Short 2023-meter distance for beginners
Return on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake
additional: In the days before the race, “Children’s Athletics” activities are held to recruit new talents for the Atlet 2004 athletics club in Pomorie. The course includes running along the Black Sea beach and returning on the dirt road beside Pomorie Lake; distances are 10.25 km and 2023 m for beginners.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run of the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.
course_highlights: International route between Ruse and Giurgiu
Road course with scenic views
Race promoting friendship between Bulgaria and Romania

description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR plant in Plovdiv. It is the largest corporate running event in southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun and charity. The event has been held in Plovdiv since 2017 and attracts companies from across the country.
